title:
Toward A Classification of Compact Homogeneous
Complex Finsler Manifolds
content: We classify all compact homogeneous smooth pseudoconvex complex Finsler manifolds. We apply a result of Tits on compact complex homogeneous space, or of H. C. Wang and Hano-Kobayashi on the classification of compact complex homogeneous manifolds with a compact reductive Lie group. In particular, They are homogeneous complex torus bundles over rational projective homogeneous manifolds. One can simply construct an invariant complex Finsler structure by the given isotropic subgroup whichis a subgroup of U(n) at any given point, and then transfer it to the whole manifold with the group action.
